note_en: Look at 这才 in 仲裁结果出来后，工厂仍不满意，这才正式起诉到法院: "only then" did the case go to court. 才 signals that something happened later or with more difficulty than expected, the opposite of 就 "already, as soon as." English needs a whole phrase ("only then," "not until") for what Chinese does with one adverb before the verb.
